patterns.note: Product grid uses generous white space around each item, creating a gallery-like presentation rather than a dense e-commerce catalog.
A unique, hand-drawn display font for the brand logo is used in stark contrast to a very minimal, light-weight sans-serif for all functional text.
The user interface is strictly monochromatic (black on white), allowing product images to be the sole source of color and visual vibrancy.
The header becomes sticky on scroll, and a secondary navigation label ('CATALOG') dynamically repositions itself to align with the main navigation links.
Each product item in the grid consistently displays an image, title, artist, year, type, price, and a simple 'ADD TO CART' button, maintaining a uniform information hierarchy.

technique_notes: The primary navigation area transitions from a static position to a fixed, sticky header upon scrolling, with a specific page indicator ('CATALOG') dynamically moving to integrate cleanly within the main navigation links.
Product listings are presented in a flexible, image-centric grid, utilizing ample white space to give each item a distinct, gallery-like presence.

The site's visual identity is built on a stark black and white foundation for all interface elements, ensuring that the diverse and often colorful product photography remains the undisputed focal point.

design_tokens.type_scale: An oversized, hand-drawn logo (~3-4x body text) contrasts sharply with small, light-weight sans-serif text used for all other elements, creating a flat hierarchy with one dominant visual anchor.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, especially around product items and in the header, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the juxtaposition of the highly unique, hand-drawn, widely-spaced logo typography with an otherwise extremely minimal, almost stark, black-and-white interface. This creates an immediate artistic and editorial impression, elevating the product photography to gallery status rather than typical e-commerce.
